# GrowGeneration to Present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on September 14-16, 2026


September 02, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_b510c126c67348e140e5dfe4fad4ac96/growgeneration/news/2026-09-02_GrowGeneration_to_Present_at_the_H_C_Wainwright_270.pdf)


DENVER, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **GrowGeneration Corp. (NASDAQ: GRWG)** (“GrowGeneration,” “GrowGen” or “the Company”), one of the nation’s largest suppliers of specialty products for controlled environment agriculture (CEA), commercial cultivation, and garden centers, today announced that Darren Lampert, GrowGen’s Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder will present virtually at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, to be held on September 14–16, 2026 in New York City.


Mr. Lampert’s presentation will be available on demand September 11, 2026 at 7:00 a.m. ET in the Investor Relations section of the GrowGen website at[https://ir.growgeneration.com/news-events/events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=7eXUXx4AwDcMNKjz5mxDxnytnNGSYWM8qBwPJUkJk86fuM5doMDt4l7THmCbPA6i_lIytkpQLQ4pMSXfCJJ2KgnOWOekxMjwGU3cX8wfQWpuVh-SnHo-h0AXeBJld19AzE7ciTcws_xIWfaIsk97hLN-ypDaTaGwivnoX2wrKr0CwA6Wmx09B3A15sdZCNva5YB_jhdSshdnQ1-ogMNFQBHUrpVwgUYku-I_gB_bcvSRYuxuOpxPBmkcdF7Ph2MFiVOL-g1O4Ky7QE3gedagT9SozIZGj5U0XyygJydAFGf0ArZJy2oFumJquU3cDmzLoJRGX4Tclqk7vaZJswPQEBsSqmrt2ykiBgSVk4_kZ3BNb3qzo0jk6Zf98DKXWNWhJ9sU7_DpohoTu4lA-ebXFQ==) or via this link:[https://journey.ct.events/view/39699ed5-47cc-428f-8563-10752de93974](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=7eXUXx4AwDcMNKjz5mxDxs_ioqKKkQLnWHmVbZE5jsLgm86TUGh_ssM-_Em2a1qw2BcYC94-p1OqPdhYFm_ZT2PPnUKzotCo_EamL4iaqgL9U9s_eogmnHiITxG8N5bk4MGFuyvTQenDVH-pZR4cxNY4P2wSyZFa6XQ5Oh-wf0I7nvZ7pw1w1chrvE6HUJSW48YTwITFZi5yO3ji6vBaO1cGj1kJuAsHeeKC81Hanx0=)

**About GrowGeneration Corp:**


GrowGen is one of the nation’s largest suppliers of specialty products for controlled environment agriculture (CEA), commercial cultivation, and garden centers. GrowGen carries and sells thousands of products, such as nutrients, additives, growing media, lighting, environmental control systems, and benching and racking, including proprietary brands such as Char Coir, Drip Hydro, Power Si, Ion lights, The Harvest Company, and more. The Company also operates an online superstore for cultivators at[growgeneration.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=IfBEiBZTktgQa4nIslmBlf57g7LPECCQB7wyLf26PqBy-tu9QogVE2Ba38stfCnsBiS97cdRuN5QP3cf-JSfPzSwk4oBJ4Fy_Hm6YKbNfB8=) , as well as a wholesale business for resellers, and a benching, racking, and storage solutions business, MMI Storage Solutions.
